'''Julio Alberto Ríos Gallego''' ([[Cali]], 22 March 1973) is a [[Colombian people|Colombian]] [[engineer]], lecturer, mentor, [[professor]] of Mathematics and Physics.

==Early life, education and family==
Born in Cali, he attended elementary and high school at Colegio Lacordaire, being the best student of his promotion.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://elpueblo.com.co/julio-rios-profesor-virtual-personaje-del-ano-2012/|title = Julio Ríos, profesor virtual, personaje del año 2012 | author = El Pueblo | date = 15 December 2012 | accessdate = 17 February 2013|language = Spanish }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url = http://www.eltiempo.com/vida-de-hoy/educacion/ARTICULO-WEB-NEW_NOTA_INTERIOR-12119072.html|title = 'Julioprofe' arrasa en la web con clases de matemáticas| author = El Tiempo| accessdate = 17 February 2013|language = Spanish }}</ref> He studied civil engineering at Universidad del Valle. He is married and father of two daughters and currently lives in Cali.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.semana.com/gente/articulo/el-profesor-colombiano-arrasa-youtube/262963-3 | title = El profesor colombiano que arrasa en YouTube | author = Semana | date = 15 August 2012 | accessdate = 17 February 2013 | language = Spanish | archive-date = 11 April 2013 | archive-url = https://archive.today/20130411185539/http://www.semana.com/gente/articulo/el-profesor-colombiano-arrasa-youtube/262963-3 | url-status = dead }}</ref>

==Career==
He has been professor in colleges and universities, such as "Colegio Hebreo Jorge Isaacs" the "''Corporación Universitaria Minuto de Dios''" and the Faculty of Medicine [[Universidad San Martín]] in Cali. Trying to motivate his students, on 6 April 2009 he went to the internet, creating virtual classes with the Julioprofe channel. His channel has 4.2 million subscribers in [[YouTube]], and more than 500 million views<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.youtube.com/user/?julioprofe/Videosview=0 | title = Julioprofe: Vídeos de Matemáticas y Física| author =YouTube | website = [[YouTube]]| date = 16 January 2012|accessdate = 17 February 2013|language = Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.medellindigital.gov.co/tagme2012/Paginas/julioalbertoriosg.aspx| title = Julio Ríos (Ponente)| author = medellindigital| year = 2012| accessdate = 17 February 2013| language = Spanish| url-status = dead| archiveurl = https://web.archive.org/web/20140317231323/http://www.medellindigital.gov.co/tagme2012/Paginas/julioalbertoriosg.aspx| archivedate = 17 March 2014}}</ref>

Known as '''Julioprofe''', he appeared in [[e-learning]] videos of [[Right to education|free education]] in the areas of: [[algebra]], [[geometry]], [[trigonometry]], [[analytic geometry]], [[computing]], [[physics]], [[linear algebra]] and higher mathematics. He uses a teaching technique where he is a professor [[Mentoring|Guardian]] and the student can learn from their [[computer]], [[smartphone]], [[iPod]], at home at any time.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://www.techcetera.co/julio-profe-una-estrella-de-las-redes-sociales-es-un-profe-de-matematicas/|title = Julio Profe: Una estrella de las redes sociales es un profe de matemáticas|author = techcetera|date = 24 July 2012|accessdate = 17 February 2013|language = Spanish|archive-date = 6 March 2013|archive-url = https://archive.today/20130306080256/http://www.techcetera.co/julio-profe-una-estrella-de-las-redes-sociales-es-un-profe-de-matematicas/|url-status = dead}}</ref>

Since September 2011, he is part of the educational project ''Academia Vasquez'', responsible for video production of algebra and representative of Colombia said educational project.<ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.academiavasquez.com/| title = Página Oficial| author = Academia Vasquez| accessdate = 17 February 2013| language = Spanish| archive-date = 6 March 2013| archive-url = https://archive.today/20130306092140/http://www.academiavasquez.com/| url-status = dead}}</ref>

In February 2013, he signed an agreement with the ''"Fundación Transformemos"'' (winner of the [[UNESCO Confucius Prize for Literacy|UNESCO Confucius Prize]] 2012), to produce videos of math<ref>{{cite web |url = http://www.transformemos.com | title = Julioprofe y Transformemos se unen | author =Fundación Transformemos | accessdate = 17 February 2013|language = Spanish}}</ref>

==Recognition==
He was nominated in "Best Leaders of Colombia Awards in 2012"<ref>{{cite web |url = http://www.semana.com/nacion/articulo/estos-mejores-lideres-colombia/263781-3 |title =Estos son los mejores líderes de Colombia |author =Semana | date = 28 August 2012 | accessdate = 17 February 2013|language = Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url =http://www.semana.com/especiales/articulo/carlos-augusto-giraldo-julio-alberto-rios-enrique-chaux/264032-3|title =Carlos Augusto Giraldo, Julio Alberto Ríos y Enrique Chaux|author = Semana| date = 1 September 2012 | accessdate = 17 February 2013}}</ref>

He was nominated the "Revolutionary Award" in 2013 in Latinos Innovation category, for his contribution to internet education, and U.S. recognition that use [[social networks]] to generate positive changes.<ref>{{cite web |url = http://www.thesocialrevolucion.com/nominee/2013-nominee-julio-alberto-rios-gallego/ |title = 2013 Nominee: Julio Alberto Ríos Gallego |author = The Social Revolution |year = 2013 |accessdate = 23 February 2013 |archive-date = 11 April 2013 |archive-url = https://archive.today/20130411231950/http://www.thesocialrevolucion.com/nominee/2013-nominee-julio-alberto-rios-gallego/ |url-status = dead }}</ref>
